players.product: Atlas and Origin agentic target-to-antibody discovery platform

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K compute supply: Absci has access to compute capacity and other services through an agreement with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) through early 2028; the remaining financial commitments for 2026, 2027 and 2028 are $4.6 million, $8.3 million and $2.3 million, respectively. Absci manages its applications and data on a combination of on-site systems and cloud-based data centers.
quarterly_data.figure: OCI compute agreement through early 2028; remaining commitments $4.6 million (2026), $8.3 million (2027), $2.3 million (2028)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K platform collaborations: as of December 31, 2025 Absci had collaborative arrangements with PrecisionLife, Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, Twist Bioscience and Owkin involving joint research and development activities, under which Absci performs drug creation activities to co-develop product candidates and the parties share in the potential value created plus cost sharing; Absci received $0.8 million of cost sharing payments and credits under these arrangements in 2025 (none in 2024). Partner program revenue was $2,800 thousand for 2025 versus $4,534 thousand for 2024. Absci relies on partners' in-house manufacturing or third-party CDMOs for cGMP manufacturing, as it has no cGMP manufacturing capability of its own.
quarterly_data.figure: collaborations with PrecisionLife, Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, Twist Bioscience, Owkin; $0.8 million cost sharing in 2025; partner program revenue $2,800 thousand (2025) vs $4,534 thousand (2024)
